name: shunt
description: Token plane: PreToolUse gates that keep whole-file reads of large files and unbounded repo-wide searches out of the main model's context, plus the delegation skills that route them to a cheap worker. On Codex CLI 0.154.0 the gates are installed per repo with scripts/install-codex.sh, because a plugin's own hooks field is read but its handlers are not yet run.

interface.shortDescription: Route large-file reads to a cheap worker
interface.longDescription: A token plane for coding agents. Two PreToolUse gates deny a whole-file read of a text file over a line limit and an unbounded repo-wide content search, and name the exits in the vocabulary of the client they run under (SHUNT_CLIENT). A delegation recipe carries the first exit: bulk-read sends the read to a cheap worker and brings back structured bullets cited as file:line. Under Claude Code the gates load with the plugin; under Codex they are installed into a repo with scripts/install-codex.sh and each handler is trusted once.
defaultPrompt: Bulk-read these files and list every public method with its file:line
